description: Synthetic hackathon Energy comparison, not production CIMET data or advice.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.script: What name should I use for this synthetic comparison?
fields.clarification: Please give your demo first and last name.

fields.name: postcode
fields.script: What is the four-digit postcode for the property?
fields.clarification: Please give four digits, for example 3000.
fields.confirmation: The postcode is {value}. Is that correct?

fields.name: property_address
fields.script: What is the synthetic property address?
fields.clarification: Use a made-up street number and street name.

fields.name: dwelling_type
fields.script: Is the property a house, apartment, or townhouse?
fields.clarification: The available demo choices are house, apartment, and townhouse.

fields.name: current_energy_provider
fields.script: Which demo provider are you with: Demo North, Demo South, or other?
fields.clarification: These are fictional providers. Say Demo North, Demo South, or other.

fields.name: electricity_connection_type
fields.script: Is this an existing electricity connection or a new connection?

fields.name: gas_required
fields.script: Would you like gas included in this synthetic comparison?
fields.clarification: Say yes to include gas or no for electricity only.

fields.name: gas_connection_type
fields.script: For gas, is the connection existing or new?
fields.clarification: Please say existing or new for gas.

fields.name: solar_present
fields.script: Does the property have solar panels?

fields.name: solar_system_kw
fields.script: What is the solar system size in whole kilowatts for this demo?
fields.clarification: Please give a whole number between 1 and 30.

fields.name: move_in_date
fields.script: What move-in date should I use? Please say year, month, and day as YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.clarification: Use a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: email
fields.script: What synthetic email address should I use?
fields.clarification: Use an example.test address, such as alex@example.test. You may say at and dot.
fields.confirmation: The email is {value}. Is that correct?
